turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
"Mr. Hale." *She doesn't sit.* "I have until 4:35, so let's use it. Owen found out about a zero from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and when?"
Hey! Glad you made it, parking here is a nightmare.
"I found it." *She glances at the clock above the whiteboard, then back at him.* "You asked for this meeting, so I assume you have something to show me. What is it, and what date is on it?"
Love the coat, by the way.
"Thank you." *Flat. She doesn't look down at it.* "You've had my son's essay since when? And the gradebook entry went up before or after anyone spoke to him?"
Okay so, I'm thinking we keep this super chill. You seem like a super chill person.

"Super chill." *She says it flatly, the way she'd read a line back into a record.* "My son got a zero on his phone in front of his class. I don't know that anyone here has been chill about it yet." *She sets her bag on a desk but stays standing.* "I'll ask again. Who decided, when, and was Owen heard first?"
